records.text: When I proofed the rye dough beside the open pantry window yesterday, its surface dried into a leathery skin. The covered bowl stayed soft.

attribution: dough_observation is original owner-reported conversation, not an accepted Claim or controlled experiment.
reader_rules: A recommendation to cover the bowl may follow the observation. Do not call this a scientifically established cause or a saved memory operation. Cite the original event.

records.text: During my slide show the projector rattled only while the loose lens cap was hanging from its tether. Holding the cap still stopped the rattle.
